intent: Author an interconnected schema with composite foreign keys, native procedure bodies and trigger formatting stress cases, keeping every unresolved requirement visible.

requirements.text: Place every source object in one dedicated database. Resolve composite key column order and the enforcing unique index before creating the child.
Include multiline bodies, comments, embedded semicolons and mixed-case literals with trailing spaces. Record the outer client terminator and compare body text losslessly.
Keep executable source records within 72 columns in the target client's encoding; document any impossible requested statement instead of truncating or rewriting literal content.
